profil.accroche: Specialized in React & TypeScript, UI/UX revamps and unit testing — from feature development to maintenance, within product teams.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I've always been passionate about new technologies, and that curiosity naturally drew me to computer science — a passion confirmed from the very start of my studies. Since then, I've kept learning and honing my skills across the modern front-end ecosystem (React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS), through projects in both product-focused and more technical environments.

These 6 years of experience have let me touch every facet of the job: building features, revamping interfaces, setting up automated testing (Vitest, Storybook), and supporting product teams day to day. I'm now furthering my skills by learning Next.js, with the goal of extending my reach into back-end work.
